title: 알잖아요: 상대도 아는 이유 말하기
objective: By the end, you can add -잖아요 to verbs, adjectives, past forms, and nouns, and you can use it only for things the listener already knows.
summary: Learn to use -잖아요 to remind someone of something they already know, often as a reason.

task.title: Use -잖아요 correctly
task.line: Write the right -잖아요 form, decide if it is natural, or fix the mistake.

forms.when: Present. Add it straight to any verb or adjective stem, with or without 받침. Sounds like [자나요]: 알잖아요 [알자나요].
forms.means: "…, you know." It reminds the listener of something they already know, often as a reason.
forms.exampleMeaning: It's raining outside, you know. Take an umbrella.

forms.when: Past. Use it for something that already happened and the listener knows about. With seniors it can sound like blaming, so be careful.
After a noun that ends in a consonant.
forms.exampleMeaning: Tomorrow is Sunday, you know. You can get up late.

forms.when: After a noun that ends in a vowel.
forms.example: 민수 씨는 요리사잖아요. 민수 씨한테 물어봐요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Minsu is a cook, you know. Ask him.

watchOut: 주말잖아요 (X) → 주말이잖아요 (O): After a noun that ends in a consonant, add 이.
어제 말하잖아요 (X) → 어제 말했잖아요 (O): For something in the past, use the past form.
(To someone you just met) 저는 미국 사람이잖아요 (X) → 저는 미국 사람이에요 (O): Use -잖아요 only for things the listener already knows, not for new information.
알쟎아요 (X) → 알잖아요 (O): It comes from -지 않아요, so write 잖, not 쟎.
exercises: Fill in the blank with -잖아요 (멀다): 걸어서 가지 마세요. 공항은 여기서 ____.
Fill in the blank with the past form (먹다): A: 왜 아무것도 안 먹어요? B: 아까 점심을 많이 ____.
Fill in the blank with the noun + -잖아요: ① A: 왜 이렇게 길에 사람이 많아요? B: 오늘이 ____. (크리스마스) ② A: 요즘 왜 늦게 자요? B: 지금 ____. (시험 기간)
Complete B's answer with -잖아요 using the words given: A: 왜 버스를 안 타요? B: ____. (출근 시간에 길이 막히다)
Is it natural? Write O or X: ① (To a coworker you just met) 저는 고양이를 두 마리 키우잖아요. ② (To your roommate, who knows you well) 저 매운 거 못 먹잖아요.
Find the mistake and correct it: 그 식당은 우리 동네 맛집잖아요.
answers: ① X (The coworker doesn't know this yet. Say 키워요.) ② O
